hotel_name: Townhouse Hotel Sec- 54 Golf Course Road

Although we have faced some issues in our room but it was all sorted so there is nothing to say negative about it. ☺️Once again thanks a lot!!
A great value for money option for business travellers like me, neat and clean and with good amenities
